entries.title: Exports name their timezone
entries.summary: every date and time in a downloaded file now carries the zone it was written in (`2026-04-01 18:30 PDT`, or an explicit offset where the zone has no abbreviation, or `UTC` where no timezone is set). Exports render in the event or organization timezone while grids render in your browser's, and neither used to say so.

entries.title: Restrict a file question to certain file types
entries.summary: **Customize Question > Accepted file types** limits a file upload question to PDF, Word, Image, or any other combination you tick, on session submission forms and awards entries alike. Sessionboard reads the file's contents rather than trusting its name, so renaming a JPEG to `.pdf` no longer gets it past a PDF-only question.

entries.title: Awards notifications send from your organization's address
entries.summary: leaving a notification's **From** field blank now means "use the organization system email" instead of a Sessionboard address that failed your domain check, so a notification saves without being hand-edited first.

entries.title: Portal audiences by source and session status
entries.summary: a contacts portal can now be filtered by **[Session] Source** (which submission or application form brought someone in, plus Manual) and by **[Session] Session Status**, including custom statuses.

entries.title: Portal due dates are enforced
entries.summary: once a task, form, or file request passes its due date, portal users can no longer mark it complete. Set an **Extended Due Date** to allow completion afterwards; already-complete items can still be reopened.

entries.title: Copied participants join the destination event
entries.summary: copying sessions with **Copy participants** on now adds those contacts to the event you copied into, so they appear in Contacts and on the session's Participants tab instead of being invisible to every event-scoped view.
